description.value: Catch 122 is a full-service restaurant in North Vancouver's Shipyards District (Lower Lonsdale), specializing in brunch, pastries, high tea, and dinner with a menu featuring house-made charcuterie, breads, and globally inspired dishes. The restaurant occupies an open dining room and bar space suited for both casual visits and private events for up to 80 guests. It is a notable destination on the North Shore waterfront for cyclists riding the lower Lonsdale area.
